reason: Both sell FDA-regulated prescription drugs through wholesalers and pharmacies, and Amneal has a specialty branded line. But Akebia is a renal-focused branded drug company with two products, selling to dialysis organizations and nephrologists. Amneal is a broad generics maker with 300+ medicines in neurology, migraine and other areas, and no stated kidney focus. Amneal makes its own drugs and Akebia uses contract manufacturers, so the overlap is partial and indirect.
